title: HNLU team wins 9th Dastur National Direct Tax Moot Court Competition; students secure top individual honours
description: A team from Hidayatullah National Law University (HNLU), Raipur, has emerged as the Winner of the 9th Dastur National Direct Tax Moot Court Competition organised by Government Law College, Mumbai, in collaboration with The Chamber of Tax Consultants.The preliminary and quarter-final rounds were conducted online on June 13, 2026, while the semi-final rounds were held at the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Mumbai, and the final round at Government Law College, Mumbai, on June 27, 2026.T
